drafts.title: I Stopped Using AI Tools, I Built an AI System Instead
drafts.caption:
Most people collect 15 AI subscriptions. We built ONE autonomous Agentic OS that runs them all locally.

Here is how it works:
1. Autonomous collectors sweep arXiv, Hacker News, & GitHub.
2. AI ranks them 0–100 by signal-to-noise ratio.
3. Content Studio drafts multi-platform copy & news cards in one click.
4. Zernio schedules across LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.

All controlled from desktop HUD or remote phone interface.

Source: https://github.com/vivekmishraishere/agentic-os-personal

memories.title: Autonomous Agent Routing SOP
memories.content: Always direct routine summarization and simple classification queries to local DeepSeek-R1 or Gemini Flash to preserve 95% token budget. Reserve Claude 3.7 Sonnet for multi-agent synthesis, code generation, and complex architecture decisions.

memories.title: Token Minimization 95% Playbook Rules
memories.content: Enabled Fast Mode + Semantic Cache. Truncate preamble instructions. Use JSON schemas instead of free-form chain of thought when invoking subagents. Reduces cost by $42/day across all active automated pipelines.

memories.title: B2B Outreach ICP: Mid-Market AI Agencies
memories.content: Focus on AI agency founders and VP of Engineering running 5-50 people teams. Pain point: managing disconnected AI tabs and token exhaustion. Hook: 'One-click unified Agent OS with Obsidian shared memory'.

memories.title: High-Retention Hook Blueprint (YouTube/Shorts)
memories.content: Hook formula: 1) Visual contradiction, 2) State exact outcome within 3.2s, 3) Tease the open-source dashboard download. Proven to maintain >74% viewer retention past the 30-second drop-off curve.

memories.title: Obsidian Vault File Hierarchy & Sync Protocol
memories.content: Vault path: /vault/agent-os/. All agents auto-commit markdown logs with YAML frontmatter tags #agent-memory, #sop, #decision. Bi-directional sync verified with zero file lock collisions.
